The licensee currently houses a breeding herd of chinchillas. The application submitted for the current license was
approved for rabbits, and no other species was approved. No application has been submitted to add the new species to
the current license. Species acquired by the licensee must be approved during a licensing inspection to make sure all
regulatory requirements for those species are met under the Animal Welfare Act.
A licensee must obtain a new license before using any animal beyond those types or numbers of animals authorized
under the existing license.
